shell_intro: Wellness estimates from your shared OmniGart profile
wellness_disclaimer: OmniGart provides wellness estimates only. Readiness, stress, HRV, Baevsky index, body-fat estimates, hydration targets, and training plans are not medical advice. Consult a qualified professional for health concerns.
info_sheet_not_medical_advice: Not medical advice. Consult a professional.
health_warning_chest_pain: Stop and seek emergency help if you feel chest pain, severe dizziness, or unusual shortness of breath during activity.
info_sheet_body: Figures such as readiness, stress, HRV, Baevsky index, body fat, and hydration are wellness estimates based on your inputs and device samples. Plans are coaching suggestions, not prescriptions.
calc_settings_intro: Choose how OmniGart estimates wellness figures such as energy use, heart-rate zones, body fat, and strength.
formula.bmr.mifflin_st_jeor.title: Mifflin–St Jeor
formula.bmr.mifflin_st_jeor.explain: Widely used resting energy estimate from weight, height, age, and sex.
formula.bmr.harris_benedict.title: Harris–Benedict (revised)
formula.bmr.harris_benedict.explain: Classic resting energy estimate; useful as an alternate wellness check.
formula.hr_max.tanaka.title: Tanaka
formula.hr_max.fox.title: Fox (220 − age)
formula.hr_max.fox.explain: Traditional max heart-rate rule of thumb from age alone.
formula.body_fat.cun_bae.title: CUN-BAE
formula.body_fat.cun_bae.explain: Body-fat percentage estimate from weight, height, age, and sex.
formula.one_rm.epley.title: Epley
formula.one_rm.epley.explain: Estimates one-rep max from a submaximal lift and rep count.
formula.one_rm.brzycki.title: Brzycki
formula.one_rm.brzycki.explain: Alternate one-rep max estimate that weights higher-rep sets differently.
formula.hr_zones.karvonen_5.title: Karvonen (5 zones)
formula.hr_zones.karvonen_5.explain: Five training zones from heart-rate reserve (resting to max).
formula.hr_zones.karvonen_3.title: Karvonen (3 zones)
formula.hr_zones.percent_hrmax_5.title: % HRmax (5 zones)
formula.hr_zones.percent_hrmax_5.explain: Five zones as percentages of estimated max heart rate.
workout_intro: Log strength sets for wellness training estimates. Figures are coaching aids, not medical advice.
onboarding_welcome_body: A few questions so we can personalise wellness estimates on your device. You can change these later in Profile.
onboarding_sex_body: Used only to choose the male or female body-map figure and sex-specific wellness equations. Not a medical record.
onboarding_birth_body: Age is used for wellness estimates such as energy use and heart-rate zones.
onboarding_health_privacy: Health data stays on your devices. OmniGart never sells it or uses it for advertising.
perm_explainer_health_body: OmniGart can read and write wellness samples (heart rate, HRV, sleep, workouts, body mass, hydration) to improve on-device estimates. Data is not used for ads or sent to unrelated third parties. You can continue without granting access.
food_intro: Log meals offline. Daily totals are wellness coaching aids, not medical advice.
workouts_zone2_body: Start an easy Zone 2 continuous run for wellness aerobic work. Heart-rate bands are coaching estimates.
workouts_zone2_unavailable: Could not schedule Zone 2 right now.
workouts_zone2_flag_off: WorkoutKit scheduling is off in this build. You can still train with the in-app watch Zone 2 session when available.
recovery_intro: Wellness recovery estimates from your profile and recent inputs. Not a diagnosis.
recovery_empty: Complete your profile to see wellness estimates.
planner_intro: Plan workouts on-device and optionally schedule a Zone 2 run into Workout.
planner_demo_zone2_notes: Continuous easy aerobic work for wellness.
planner_schedule_body: Send a Zone 2 continuous run into the system Workout app when scheduling is enabled.
profile_intro: Edit the details from onboarding. Changes stay on this device.
